packages.name: Quick read
packages.summary: A first look at what you have: an idea, a pitch deck, a brief or a working product. We tell you what is missing before you spend more.
includes: A short written note on gaps and risks
A call to talk it through
packages.bestFor: Early ideas and briefs that need a second pair of eyes.

packages.name: Viability review
packages.summary: We test the idea against the problem, the people it serves, the process it changes and what it would take to build.
includes: A go, change or stop recommendation
packages.bestFor: Founders and teams deciding whether to commit a budget.

packages.name: Full feasibility
packages.summary: A feasibility study you can put in front of a board, investors or a vendor.
includes: Options compared, with risks and a recommended route
packages.bestFor: Larger changes, system choices and funding decisions.
